description_en: Queries the elastic scaling history of an instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeAutoScalingHistory接口，查询实例弹性伸缩历史信息
kebab_example: aliyun das describe-auto-scaling-history --instance-id rm-2ze8g2am976240000 --auto-scaling-task-type SPEC --start-time 1675833788056 --end-time 1676605305796 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAutoScalingHistory

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

Currently, only ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances are supported
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

当前仅支持RDS MySQL实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The type of elastic scaling task to query. Currently, only SPEC is supported, which indicates querying the automatic performance scaling history
parameters.help_zh: 查询的弹性伸缩业务种类。当前仅支持SPEC，表示仅支持查询自动性能扩展历史信息
parameters.name: auto_scaling_task_type

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query task. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

The start time cannot be earlier than 45 days before the current time
parameters.help_zh:
查询任务的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

查询任务的开始时间最大不能早于当前时间45天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query task. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.
The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
查询任务结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。
查询任务结束时间需晚于查询任务开始时间
parameters.name: end_time

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success

Bandwidth.description_en: The Redis bandwidth elastic scaling history records. This parameter is not supported
Bandwidth.description_zh: Redis带宽弹性伸缩历史记录，暂不支持

items.description_en: The Redis bandwidth elastic scaling history information
items.description_zh: Redis带宽弹性伸缩历史信息

Resource.description_en: The Redis resource scaling history records. This parameter is not supported
Resource.description_zh: Redis资源扩容历史记录，暂不支持

items.description_en: The Redis resource scaling history information

Shard.description_en: The Redis automatic shard scaling history records. This parameter is not supported
Shard.description_zh: Redis自动分片扩容历史记录，暂不支持

items.description_en: The Redis automatic shard scaling history information
items.description_zh: Redis自动分片扩容历史信息

SpecHistory.description_en: The automatic performance extension history records
SpecHistory.description_zh: 自动性能扩展历史记录

items.description_en: The automatic performance extension history information
items.description_zh: 自动性能扩展历史信息

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code returned by the internal scaling task. Valid values:

Insufficient_Balance: The account balance is insufficient or there are unpaid orders.
REACH_SPEC_UPPERBOUND: The upper limit of the instance specification has been reached.
Control_Error_Timeout_Msg: The control task timed out.
Invoke_Rds_Api_Error_Msg: Failed to call the RDS API
ErrorCode.description_zh:
扩缩容内部任务返回的错误码：

Insufficient_Balance ：用户余额不足或存在未支付订单。
REACH_SPEC_UPPERBOUND ：已达到用户规格上限。
Control_Error_Timeout_Msg ：管控任务超时。
Invoke_Rds_Api_Error_Msg ：调用RDS API失败

OriginCore.description_en: The number of CPU cores of the original instance

OriginMemory.description_en: The memory size of the original instance. Unit: GB
OriginMemory.description_zh: 原始实例内存大小，单位GB

ScaleType.description_en:
The type of the automatic performance extension task. Valid values:
SCALE_UP: Automatic specification extension.
SCALE_DOWN: Automatic specification scale-down
ScaleType.description_zh:
自动性能扩展任务类型，取值：
SCALE_UP：规格自动扩容。
SCALE_DOWN：规格自动缩容

TargetCore.description_en: The number of CPU cores of the target instance

TargetMemory.description_en: The memory size of the target instance. Unit: GB
TargetMemory.description_zh: 目标实例内存大小，单位GB

TaskExcuteStatus.description_en:
The task execution status. Valid values:
true: The task was executed successfully.
false: The task failed
TaskExcuteStatus.description_zh:
任务执行状态：
true：执行成功。
false：执行失败

TaskTime.description_en: The task execution time. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
TaskTime.description_zh: 任务执行时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

Storage.description_en: The storage expansion history records. This parameter is not supported
Storage.description_zh: 存储扩容历史记录，暂不支持

items.description_en: The instance storage expansion history information
items.description_zh: 实例存储扩容历史信息

Message.description_en:
The returned message.
If the request is successful, Successful is returned. If the request fails, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
